body:
Let’s welcome Margaret Ave Park!
Have you heard? A new park is coming to the neighbourhood at the southeast corner of Margaret Avenue North and Neilson Avenue.
The City of Waterloo is working with SHIFT Landscape Architecture to weave your ideas into a park that reflects your needs and honours the neighbourhood’s history. This will be a brand-new space for the neighbourhood, creating important parkland and bringing a variety of activities and features to the community.
Through engagement, we hope to learn about the local community and understand how Margaret Ave Park can fit seamlessly into the neighbourhood.
About Margaret Ave Park
Margaret Ave Park will bring a new park space to the Lincoln Heights neighbourhood. It will be located at the intersection of Margaret Avenue North and Neilson Avenue with an approximate area of 0.25 hectares.
Stay informed
Throughout the project, there will be several opportunities for you to provide input and learn about project updates. Upcoming engagement events are listed under Key Dates on this page.
Subscribe for updates about news and information about this project by clicking +Follow in the banner.
